If a model is built over a strict subset of the network’s snapshots, `solve_model` still calls the callback with `n.snapshots`, rather than `_model_snapshots(n)`. Under legacy semantics with the default/`"auto"` or `"multiindex"` setting, the context does not enable flattening and `_to_model` leaves that full index unchanged, so the callback receives more snapshots than the model was built over.
